notes: App turned into its service with test::init_service, called with an actix_http::Request built per call from a parsed method and URI. Param handlers extract web::Path<String>; replies are empty.
details: The application service is what actix-web's HTTP layer calls for each request; test::init_service is the documented way to get it without a server. Each call makes an actix_http::Request (from actix-http's message pool) and sets the method and the URI parsed once per fixture; test::TestRequest is not used because it also builds a resource map and configuration per request. 50 resources hold two method routes each. Handlers return HttpResponse::Ok(); a miss gets the empty 404 or 405 of actix-web.
